text.p: Italian bonds and Btp futures ended firmer on a burst of late short-covering amid market relief a domestic government crisis seemed to have been averted with a compromise with the opposition over an Albanian mission.
Romano Prodi's centre-left government worked out a joint motion with the centre-right Freedom Alliance over the deployment of a security force for Albania.

The Chamber of Deputies (lower house) is expected to vote on the Italian-led mission at around 1800 GMT. Prodi earlier said he would ask President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro to decide his fate if key ally Communist Refoundation failed to back him.
